purpose: manajasyārthena (likely corrupt for manujasyārthena, 'for the sake of mankind')
notes: No historical human persons are named. Aṃgaḍakumāra refers to the epic/mythical character Aṅgada and forms part of the text title/section. The phrase 'liṣiti manajasyārthena' appears to be a corrupt scribal formula for 'likhitaṃ manujasyārthena' (written for the benefit of humanity/others) rather than a personal name.
